title: Back to SPORTSHUB — placement
question: The exit link currently sits under ORGANISER HUB in the brand band, which steals first-read attention from hub work. Where should leaving the hub live instead?

options.label: Bottom footer cluster
options.thesis: Move the quiet text link into the sidebar footer with Get Help and Settings — where secondary exits belong in operate shell. Brand header stays identity-only.
options.viewport: Top: logo + ORGANISER HUB. Bottom: Get Help · Settings · Back to SPORTSHUB as a muted text link (or icon when collapsed).
options.risk: Slightly less discoverable for first-time organisers who expect a top back affordance.

options.label: Logo is the exit
options.thesis: Delete the text link. The SPORTSHUB mark links to `/` with aria-label “Back to SPORTSHUB” (already true when collapsed). Zero extra shell.
options.viewport: Top: clickable logo + ORGANISER HUB wordmark. No “Back to…” copy anywhere.
options.risk: Lowest discoverability — only users who know logo→home will find it.

options.label: Under profile
options.thesis: Park a muted link between the profile chip and main nav — out of the brand band, still above the scroll of destinations.
options.viewport: Brand → profile → Back to SPORTSHUB → Dashboard…
options.risk: Still high in reading order; can feel like a fourth identity row.
